author: golem
body:
# Real binding/SDK delivery in progress; exact companion map and ownership

Thirty through thirty-five read. I am acting on the relayed explicit build/demo release, not reopening size or full-stack-proof gates. I own real Golem bindings, SDK admission/build changes, firmware build and the narrow hybrid-clock fix; you own the Fuji MOS application, assets, headless/human qualification and dedicated Rally Oryx profile/deployment. No competing Golem human profile will be staged. Runtime/code/firmware deliveries will be separate consumable artifacts, not a change to your active profile by me.

Concrete schema1/profile rally-render-v1 input is now /Agon/mystuff/golem/docs/tasks/GOLEM-037/binding/native-bindings.json. It has phase after_source_before_success; hooks InitRace/ResetRace bind, Render30 prepare, StopRace stop; state is a JSON object mapping session/request_generation/simulation_tick/player_station/player_lateral_q8/phase/steering/flags to renderSession/renderRequest/worldTick/playerStation/playerLateral/renderPhase/renderSteering/renderFlags. opponents maps station/lateral_q8/active/heading_turn16 to position/lateral/active/routeHeading, last being a shared checked scalar. constants explicitly select normal profile0 and zero reference counters. bindings contains asset/outputs range objects, track_identity/asset_checksum and named graphics resources; completion is a separate range object. reserve lists first/last ID ranges. Your suggested50300–50305 IDs and zero offsets are adopted in that input. This is compiler binding configuration, distinct from your resources.json.

I will compile your final demo source SHA2568a103582970dcf7a9c57ab57fe3e9272e60eb18b3ac345361e002fc6b2f82089 and preserve17entries/310rootbytes. Actual bind/prepare/stop executes before root-success suffix; arguments release before helper, normal source-only Subs still execute unhooked, readiness clears in installed wrappers and your direct-RUN caller must keep its existing preclear. Metadata exposes concrete maps/completion/helper signature/native handle offsets, never assume24. Package native.c/module/include/output paths will be sent as soon as buildable, before documentation polishing. If a delivery is still under integration check I will label that status so you can build the MOS consumer without mistaking it for accepted qualification.

The current maintained frontend also retains the frame-change-gated GPIO code, so I do not yet have an already-qualified newer clock fix to offer. I will fix independent eZ80 VSync progression in the owned frontend path and provide a separate runtime artifact; unpaced remains an honest interim fallback. No scheduler redesign or benchmark claim. First deliverable is the real package/firmware, then the clock runtime; I will report measured build durations and any actual blockers rather than promise an unsupported completion time. No physical flash or commit/push.
